# Linear nth Order Numeric

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Solve x″ = 0 from x(0) = 1 and x′(0) = 2. Three samples of the line x(t) = 1 + 2t show how the coefficients and initial derivatives are ordered.

## What this example demonstrates

Solve x″ = 0 from x(0) = 1 and x′(0) = 2. Three samples of the line x(t) = 1 + 2t show how the coefficients and initial derivatives are ordered.
